description: Five digit countdown timer: it counts down from the value set on the display and puts out a gate and a trigger when it reaches zero

params.text: Adds one to that digit of the count, stopping at 9; pressing it while the timer runs also changes the value the timer will return to on a reset
Takes one off that digit of the count, stopping at 0; pressing it while the timer runs also changes the value the timer will return to on a reset
Starts the count running; once it has started, pressing again does nothing unless the Retrigger menu option is on, in which case the count starts over
Sets the count back to its starting value, stops it and arms it so that it can be triggered again

inputs.text: Each rising edge takes one off the count; with nothing patched the count steps down once a second
A rising edge sets the count back to its starting value and arms it again, in parallel with the RESET button
A rising edge starts the count running, in parallel with the TRIGGER button

outputs.text: Goes to 10V when the count reaches zero and stays there until a reset
A 1ms trigger at the moment the count reaches zero

notes: the display shows the count as it stands, and the RETRIGGER lamp is lit while the Retrigger menu option is on
patching the END gate or trigger output back into the TRIGGER input makes the timer restart itself, turning it into a clock divider
menu: Retrigger — makes each trigger restart the count from the beginning rather than being ignored while the timer runs

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
